title: Envelope
description: The frame every message on the bus uses (CLAUDE.md invariant 4). Serialized as a MessagePack map with exactly these keys. The body is constrained by the topic's own schema at the version given in `v`.

topic.description: Dotted namespace, e.g. 'audio.transcript'. Subscriptions may use a trailing '*' segment for prefix matching ('audio.*'); the wildcard never appears in a published topic.

ts.description: Capture time in seconds, CLOCK_MONOTONIC (float64). Comparable across processes on one machine; used by `jv tap --latency` for per-hop latency. NOT wall-clock — wall time is stamped by consumers that archive (jv-memory, Phase 4+).

seq.description: Per-publisher counter, strictly increasing per (src, topic). Gaps visible to a subscriber = frames dropped by the slow-consumer policy.

conf.description: Producer confidence (invariant 4). Perception topics: model confidence. Command/state topics: 1.0. Consumers MUST handle missing/late/low-confidence input.

v.description: Schema version of `body` for this topic. Bumped only by a reviewed schema-change commit (invariant 2).

body.description: Topic-specific payload; see the topic's schema file.
